summary: Configured a persistent NFSv4 share from node1:/srv/nfs/shared to node2:/mnt/shared. The dataops identity is UID/GID 4500 on both nodes, the shared directory is mode 2770, bidirectional writes retain UID/GID 4500, and the configuration survived sequential reboots of both nodes.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine-compatible nfs-utils without changing Alpine 3.23.3 or kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.
Created dataops with UID/GID 4500 on both nodes.
Configured and enabled the node1 NFS export, restricted to node2.
Configured node2's persistent fstab mount and enabled nfsmount.
Verified bidirectional reads and writes with mode 660 files under the setgid directory.
Safely rebooted node2 and node1 sequentially, verifying changed boot identities and full recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: NFS export and persistent client mount
evidence.summary: The export is active on node1, /mnt/shared is mounted from node1 over NFSv4, and both OpenRC configurations remained active after reboot.
Both nodes use dataops UID/GID 4500; the shared directory is 2770 and created files are consistently owned 4500:4500 with mode 660.
Files created on each node were read from the other, including a successful end-to-end write after both reboots.
Initial and final observations show Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts on both nodes.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from ae3f75bb-ce05-468a-82cb-e4f86bdc4b02 to 0f9e3c4a-5e7e-475f-adaa-c552ad43721e; mount, identity, data, permissions, and writes recovered.
